# HelloWebDesign

> A husband-and-wife web design and social media studio based in Urmston, Greater Manchester. Hanna and Rachid build affordable, well-crafted websites and manage social media for small businesses across Manchester and beyond. You work directly with the two owners from first chat to launch — no account managers, no juniors, no handoffs.

## About

- Independent, two-person studio (Hanna and Rachid).
- Based in Urmston, serving Greater Manchester and the surrounding towns; most work is done remotely with on-site visits when helpful.
- Transparent pricing — the price quoted is the price paid, with no hidden fees.
- Contact: contact@hellowebdesign.co.uk · +44 7763 648866
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hellowebdesignco/ · Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/hello.web.design.uk/

## Services & pricing

- **Starter Site** — one-page site, mobile responsive, contact form, live within a week. From £499.
- **Business Pro** — multi-page custom website with advanced SEO setup and Google integration. Custom-quoted.
- **E-Commerce** — full online shop with secure payments, order management and product catalogue. Custom-quoted.
- **Wedding Websites** — RSVP form, venue & travel info, custom photo gallery. From £499.
- **Add-ons** — Social Media Management, Web Applications, Mobile Apps, Business Process Consultancy.

## Care plans (post-launch support)

- **Essentials — £19/mo**: secure hosting & domain renewal, SSL, daily backups, software & security updates, uptime monitoring, email support.
- **Complete — £49/mo**: everything in Essentials plus up to 1 hour of edits each month, priority support, monthly performance check, seasonal tweaks. No contracts — cancel any time.
